text:
cloud-init for rpi-image-gen

Sample skeleton for using cloud-init with rpi-image-gen. Partially borrowed from the pi-gen cloud-init configuration.

Scope

This contribution is a NoCloud example, not full built-in cloud-init support. The example expects cloud-init seed data from separate CIDATA media as described below.

The image.json generated by rpi-image-gen is an Image Description Provisioning (IDP) document used by Raspberry Pi provisioning tooling. It is not a Raspberry Pi Imager customisation manifest, and loading it into Imager does not make an image cloud-init/customisation capable.

An image must contain and enable the appropriate first-boot or cloud-init integration for Imager-provided customisation data to take effect.

See the project provisioning documentation for the IDP format and scope.

Usage
Fill in the applicable details in the config/pi-cloud-init.yaml.
Build and provision the image as usual.
On a FAT32 formatted USB drive with exactly the label CIDATA, add meta-data, network-config, and user-data. The details of what should be in those files can be found at https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/, with sample files in this repo under the directory NoCloud-USB.
